senses.gloss: f.(b. h. חֲנֻפָה, some ed. חֲנֻפָּ׳; חָנַף)hypocrisy, dishonesty, flattery.
units: <cite ref="Sotah 41b:14">Sot. 41ᵇ</cite> <he>אדם שיש בו ח׳</he> a man in whom there is insincerity.
<cite ref="Sotah 41b:7">Ib.</cite> <he>אגרופה של ח׳</he> the power of flattery (towards Agrippa).
<cite ref="Sotah 42a:2">Ib. 42ᵃ</cite> <he>עדה … ח׳</he> a community in which insincerity (flattery to power) prevails.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 52a:14">Snh. 52ᵃ</cite> <he>בשביל ח׳ שהחניפו לקרח</he> because they flattered Korah.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 49b:6">Kidd. 49ᵇ</cite> <he>ח׳ וגסות וכ׳</he> cringing submission (to power) and haughtiness (towards the weak); a. e.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 48">Gen. R. s. 48</cite>, beg. <he>כל ח׳ וכ׳</he> where the root <he>חנף</he> is used in the Bible, it means heresy; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 304">Yalk. Is. 304</cite>.
